_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Oli muzannyi {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Ekigendererwa kyo kuzizza kamu kamu kaakano (ku mpiso, ku ndagala, oba ku mpeefu).
Ku luzannya lwo, onaanwa okuteeka nambari y'esaala (0-8) oyagala kuteeka ekiteeko kyo.
Ku nnya, '[4]' kikiteeka ekiteeko kyo mu saala ey'omukise.
Ng'oye muzannyi {player_id}, oli {symbol}, wabula omusana wo ali {opponent_symbol}.

invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si selula entuufu. Erina okubeera wakati wa 0 ne 8.

game_action.placed: Omuzannyi {player_id} yaweereza ekiteeko kye ({symbol}) mu saala {cell}.
